title: Idle Village Crew Scheduler Visual Debug Panel
objectives: Create visual debug panel for crew scheduler
Display crew scheduler state, assignments, and constraints
Provide real-time visualization of scheduler operations
Enable debugging and inspection of scheduler behavior
invariants: Config-first: All scheduler configuration from crewScheduler.ts
Style Lab: Apply Style Lab tokens for UI theming
Persistence: All state changes through async PersistenceService
Component Reuse: Use existing UI primitives where possible
WS3 Integration: Integrate with WS3 crew scheduler system

operations.description: Create useCrewSchedulerDebug.ts hook that provides debug state and inspection methods for crew scheduler
Create CrewSchedulerDebugPanel.tsx with visual display of scheduler state, assignments, and constraints
Implement real-time visualization of scheduler operations and state changes
Apply Style Lab tokens for theming throughout the debug panel
Create unit tests for debug hook and panel components

guardrails: DO NOT modify crew scheduler runtime behavior - only visualization
DO NOT hardcode scheduler configuration - read from crewScheduler.ts
DO NOT create new scheduler logic - only debug UI
Ensure debug panel does not interfere with normal scheduler operation
acceptance_criteria: Real-time visualization of scheduler operations works
Debug panel provides useful inspection methods
Style Lab tokens are applied correctly
Unit tests pass for debug hook and panel
Debug panel does not interfere with normal scheduler operation
notes: WS3 crew scheduler system is implemented. This task provides visual debugging capabilities for the scheduler to aid in development and troubleshooting.
